models.code:
class Customer(Base):
    __tablename__ = 'customer'

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True)
    name = Column(String)
    credit_limit = Column(Decimal, nullable=False)
    balance = Column(Decimal, default=0)
models.description: Customer data model with a balance column derived from unpaid orders.
models.name: Customer

models.code:
class Order(Base):
    __tablename__ = 'order'

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True)
    customer_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey('customer.id'))
    date_shipped = Column(DateTime)
    notes = Column(String)
    amount_total = Column(Decimal, default=0)  # Derived from items
models.description: Order data model with a note and total amount derived from items.
models.name: Order

models.code:
class Item(Base):
    __tablename__ = 'item'

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True)
    order_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey('order.id'))
    product_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey('product.id'))
    quantity = Column(Integer)
    unit_price = Column(Decimal)
    amount = Column(Decimal)  # Derived from quantity and unit price
models.description: Item data model with unit price copied from product and amount derived.
models.name: Item

models.code:
class Product(Base):
    __tablename__ = 'product'

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True)
    name = Column(String)
    unit_price = Column(Decimal)
models.description: Product data model holding basic product information.
models.name: Product

rules.name: ConstraintCustomerBalanceCreditLimit
rules.description: Customer's balance must be less than credit_limit
rules.code: Rule.constraint(validate=Customer, as_condition=lambda row: row.balance <= row.credit_limit, error_msg='Customer balance ({row.balance}) exceeds credit limit ({row.credit_limit})')

rules.name: SumCustomerBalance
rules.description: Sum of Order amount_total where date_shipped is null.
rules.code: Rule.sum(derive=Customer.balance, as_sum_of=Order.amount_total, where=lambda row: row.date_shipped is None)

rules.name: SumOrderAmountTotal
rules.description: Order's amount_total is derived as sum of Item amount.

rules.name: CopyItemUnitPrice
rules.description: Item unit_price is copied from Product unit_price

rules.name: SendOrderToKafka
rules.description: Send Order to Kafka when date_shipped is not None.
rules.code: Rule.after_flush_row_event(on_class=Order, calling=kafka_producer.send_row_to_kafka, if_condition=lambda row: row.date_shipped is not None, with_args={'topic': 'order_shipping'})
